authority_rule: For RESPECT-specific requirements, trust only active UstadMobile/Respect code, tests, fixtures, and repository metadata. RESPECT prose documentation is non-authoritative context only. Official standards documentation is authoritative only for its own standard or platform.

requirements.summary: Load and parse a RESPECT app manifest as JSON with the current RESPECT code fields.
requirements.observable_oracle: Manifest parses into the active RespectAppManifest fields and required fields are present.
requirements.positive_fixture: Valid web and native demo appmanifest fixtures from UstadMobile/Respect.
requirements.negative_fixture: Invalid JSON or missing required fields: name, license, learningUnits, defaultLaunchUri.

requirements.summary: Validate manifest title, description, and license metadata.
requirements.standard_family: RESPECT manifest and SPDX license identifiers
requirements.observable_oracle: Title is nonblank and no more than 80 characters; description when present is nonblank and no more than 4000 characters; license is an SPDX identifier known to the code's license list or the literal proprietary.
requirements.positive_fixture: Manifest with AGPL-3.0 and normal localized name/description.
requirements.negative_fixture: Overlong title, blank description, invalid license string.

requirements.summary: Validate manifest website, icon, and learningUnits link behavior.
requirements.observable_oracle: Website is present and reachable; explicit icon or acceptable favicon exists; learningUnits responds with acceptable JSON or OPDS MIME type.
requirements.positive_fixture: Native demo and case_valid resources served from a local test server with correct headers.
requirements.negative_fixture: 404 website, no icon/fallback favicon, wrong learningUnits MIME type.

requirements.summary: Validate Android package ID declared in the RESPECT app manifest.
requirements.observable_oracle: android.packageId contains only letters, digits, period, underscore, or dollar sign when present.
requirements.negative_fixture: Package ID with spaces or hyphen.

requirements.summary: Validate OPDS learning-unit catalog and publication entries.
requirements.observable_oracle: learningUnits resolves to parseable OPDS feed or publication data with metadata and launch/resource links sufficient for a learning unit.
requirements.negative_fixture: Malformed OPDS JSON, missing publication metadata, missing acquisition or launch link.

requirements.summary: Validate HTTP cache-readiness for manifest, catalog, and selected learning-unit resource links.
requirements.observable_oracle: Initial GET returns 200, acceptable MIME type where specified, Content-Length, ETag or Last-Modified, and conditional GET returns 304.
requirements.positive_fixture: Local test server with correct validators and 304 handling.
requirements.negative_fixture: Missing validator headers, missing Content-Length, wrong MIME type, conditional request returns 200.
requirements.deferral_rationale: The requested Vary policy is not backed by inspected active RESPECT code and should be warning or clarification, not hard failure.

requirements.summary: Validate xAPI statement receipt for launch, progress, and completion evidence.
requirements.observable_oracle: Fake LRS accepts syntactically valid xAPI statements, rejects malformed statements, records session-scoped receipt, and can reset fixtures.
requirements.negative_fixture: Invalid response statement fixture and missing required statement envelope fields.
requirements.deferral_rationale: Full ADL LRS conformance is out of scope for v0.1.

requirements.summary: Validate RESPECT launch URL and certification session parameters.
requirements.observable_oracle: Fake launcher can generate a deterministic launch URL and session record with explicit certification, replay, or test mode labels.
requirements.positive_fixture: Native demo manifest plus generated session fixture.
requirements.negative_fixture: Missing launch version, missing endpoint, production label used for test evidence.
requirements.deferral_rationale: Inspected active RESPECT code did not expose a complete standalone compatibility runner contract.

requirements.summary: Validate Android App Links domain association when native Android metadata is supplied.
requirements.standard_family: Android App Links and Digital Asset Links
requirements.observable_oracle: Given host, package ID, and certificate fingerprints, fetch assetlinks.json and verify the package/fingerprint relation.
requirements.negative_fixture: Missing assetlinks file, wrong package, wrong fingerprint.
requirements.deferral_rationale: Need owner decision on fingerprint source for debug/release builds.

requirements.summary: Emit human-readable, JSON, and JUnit XML-compatible reports with stable rule IDs.
requirements.observable_oracle: Every rule result includes rule ID, severity, source URI, expected value, observed value, diagnostic message, and evidence pointer.

requirements.summary: Route unsupported RESPECT-specific claims to suite_test_candidate, spec_clarification_needed, or out_of_scope_for_v0_1.
requirements.observable_oracle: No RESPECT-specific rule may be marked required unless backed by active RESPECT code, test, fixture, or explicit owner decision.
requirements.positive_fixture: Unsupported Vary policy classified as clarification or warning.
requirements.negative_fixture: Unsupported requirement promoted to hard failure.
